captions.detailed: This 3D model is a desktop business card holder with a wedge-shaped profile. It features a wide, flat front face that is angled backward, providing a prominent surface for displaying a logo. The corners of the main body are rounded, and a deep, angled slot is cut into the top surface to hold business cards securely at a matching angle.
captions.instruction: Design a customizable business card holder in OpenSCAD with a wedge-shaped profile. The holder should feature rounded corners, an angled slot for holding cards, and a customizable surface logo on the front face, with parameters to adjust the slot size, overall dimensions, and logo height.
captions.factory: The code constructs a wedge-shaped card holder by first assembling a base plate and an angled main body using combinations of cubes and cylinders to create rounded corners. A difference operation is then applied to cut a rectangular card slot at a 30-degree angle using a rotated cube. Finally, a surface-mapped logo image is subtracted from the front face of the holder to create an inset or raised logo texture.
